title: Variant-Specific Rewiring of Lysosomal Positioning by STARD9 Produces Opposite Cholesterol Trafficking Outcomes.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: Residual cardiovascular risk persists despite lipid-lowering therapy, independent of LDL and Lp(a), reflecting cholesterol dysregulation. We identify STARD9, a lysosomal cholesterol-sensing kinesin, as a causal gene for divergent familial dyslipidemias and premature atherosclerosis.
